title: Ite, rime dolenti, ite, sospiri (Rore)
desc: Cipriano de Rore, Ite, rime dolenti, ite, sospiri, 1515-1565. 5 voices (cantus, altus, tenor, quintus, bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0025); edited by Maxime Popineau, Vincent Besson, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
